## isva-p04-v32 — argument map

**Speaker.** Utpaladeva (siddhāntin)

**Question.** Without desiring?

**Premises.**
- So (tathā), without (vinā) desiring-to-make (cikīrṣāṃ), no wondrous-making arising (vicitraracanodbhavaḥ).
- There'd be mere grossness (sthūlatāmātram), not (na) world-useful (lokopayoginī) — but (tu).

**Inference.** No will, no wonders: mere grossness, never world-good.
